summary:
Space Mission Design Game is an interactive and educational game designed to make space exploration fun and interesting. In this game, users can create their own space missions by selecting rockets, choosing destinations, managing fuel, and planning resources. Players can explore different planets and complete mission-based challenges. The game helps users understand basic concepts of space science, mission planning, and problem-solving through interactive activities. It combines learning with entertainment and encourages creativity, logical thinking, and decision-making skills. This project aims to make space education more engaging and accessible for students and space enthusiasts.
Project Details – Space Mission Design Game

Our project, Space Mission Design Game, is an interactive educational game that allows users to design and manage their own space missions.

Working: Users can select rockets, choose planets as destinations, calculate fuel requirements, manage resources, and complete different space mission challenges. The game provides an interactive experience where users can learn through activities and challenges.

Benefits: It improves problem-solving skills, logical thinking, creativity, decision-making, and knowledge about space exploration.

Innovation: The creative idea of this project is combining space science with gaming. Instead of only reading about space missions, users can experience mission planning through a game.
